pokedexEntries.bk: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

pokedexEntries.wh: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It changes so it looks just like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

pokedexEntries.us: This Pokémon has a cowardly disposition, so when it’s not around friends, it basically always stays transformed as something else.

pokedexEntries.um: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

pokedexEntries.sw: Zorua is a timid Pokémon. This disposition seems to be what led to the development of Zorua’s ability to take on the forms of other creatures.

pokedexEntries.sh: Zorua sometimes transforms into a person and goes into cities to search for food. When Zorua does this, it usually takes on the form of a child.
